requirements.title: DELIM values are APOSTROPHE, QUOTE, or NONE
requirements.definition: The scalar default character expression in a DELIM= specifier shall evaluate to APOSTROPHE, QUOTE, or NONE.

pending.delim-apostrophe-value: Positive source/control uses DELIM="APOSTROPHE" in a context admitted by 12.6.2.1; trailing blanks/case-insensitivity remain covered by 12.6.2.1 p4.
pending.delim-quote-value: Positive source/control uses DELIM="QUOTE" in a context admitted by 12.6.2.1; trailing blanks/case-insensitivity remain covered by 12.6.2.1 p4.
pending.delim-none-value: Positive source/control uses DELIM="NONE" in a context admitted by 12.6.2.1; trailing blanks/case-insensitivity remain covered by 12.6.2.1 p4.
pending.delim-other-value-source-control: Source-control negative changes only the DELIM= value to an unlisted token such as "MAYBE"; no numbered diagnostic is claimed for this unnumbered value rule.

requirements.title: DELIM temporarily changes the connection delimiter mode
requirements.definition: The DELIM= specifier temporarily changes the delimiter mode for the connection.

pending.delim-temporary-change: Use list-directed or namelist output of a nonblank character value on a connection opened DELIM="QUOTE" and a statement DELIM="APOSTROPHE"; assert only delimiter behavior fixed by 13.10/13.11 and then INQUIRE(DELIM=; 12.10.2.8) sentinel reports QUOTE. Use statement DELIM="QUOTE" on a connection opened DELIM="APOSTROPHE" and distinguish delimiters in output; post-statement INQUIRE verifies restoration. DELIM="NONE" uses a character value requiring no delimiter under 13.10.4, with exact limitations owned there.
pending.delim-mode-restored-after-statement: The temporary-change plans explicitly pre-establish a nondefault connection mode with OPEN, perform one data transfer with a different statement specifier, and use post-transfer INQUIRE with a nonmatching sentinel to assert restoration rather than merely successful transfer.

requirements.title: Omitted DELIM leaves the connection delimiter mode unchanged
requirements.definition: If the DELIM= specifier is omitted, the delimiter mode is not changed.

pending.omitted-delim-does-not-change-mode: Open with DELIM="QUOTE", perform list-directed/namelist output omitting DELIM= after sentinel initialization, and INQUIRE(DELIM=; 12.10.2.8) expecting QUOTE.

accounting.rationale: Single paragraph mixes DELIM= value restriction, temporary mode effect/restoration, and omitted-specifier no-change rule.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.6.2.2-12.6.2.16, the individual io-control-spec specifiers (batch160). Every unit hash-verified by independent reviewers across two rounds. Each temporary mode specifier is split into its value restriction, its one-statement effect with restoration of the connection mode (observed by INQUIRE after the statement), and the omitted-means-unchanged rule. Round 1 found a pending plan expecting exact output from I2 on a positive value without fixing the sign mode; it now uses SS, and a sweep found no other plus-, leading-zero- or rounding-dependent exact output. R1215 and C1232 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
